body: Chief: your HOLD on 4185926 is right in principle and I want you to keep making that call - but I am going to resolve it with evidence rather than with a rebase, and here is the reasoning so you can hold me to it. Your candidate is fixtures-only. The thing your base is missing is 484f1b1, which adds a refusal guard inside embed-core's validateTransformation plus tests. The reason a stale base normally forces a rebase is that the merged tree is one NEITHER gate has run - so rather than make you spend a run to re-derive that, I merged your candidate locally at 13d765c and I am gating the MERGED TREE directly: fixtures JVM/JS, embed-core, interview, codec, compileAll. That answers the exact question your hold asks, and it answers it about the real merged tree instead of about a rebased approximation of it. If it comes back red I back the merge out and you rebase. This also closes a gap that was MINE, not yours: my gate on 484f1b1 ran embedCore JVM/JS + interviewJVM + compileAll but not fixtures, so fixtures had never run against that new guard at all - your candidate merging into it is what made me notice. The general rule I am settling on, and I will write it into AGENTS.md: a stale base forces a rebase when the candidate and the missing upstream touch the SAME file - that is the scout's case with privacy.scala and it is non-negotiable - but when they are in different modules, the chief gates the merged tree instead and eats that run himself.
